verdict.rationale: Appwrite's self-hosting docs explicitly promise 'full control over data location,' letting users deploy on infrastructure of their choosing to satisfy residency needs, and compliance certifications (SOC-2, HIPAA, BAA) are mentioned for enterprise use. However, there's no evidence of a built-in region-selection feature for Appwrite Cloud users—residency is only achievable by self-hosting your own instance, not a native platform setting.
